C0315.title: Guangzhou Police Dismantle Telecom Insider Ring for Mass WeChat Account Registration
C0315.summary: Between February and March 2021, Guangzhou police took down two insider rings within the telecommunications industry. The groups exploited internal access to bulk-obtain unactivated mobile numbers and verification codes, using proprietary software to register an average of 39,000 WeChat accounts per day.
